notes: Gottlieb System 80 Step 18 switch test per the Black Hole manual page 13, part e: the matrix addresses 74, 75, 76, 77, 57, which parts a-c did not reach because the ROM leaves the test about 127 s after entering Step 18 or when 57 closes. Self/Test (07) and Credit (47) enter Step 16 and two more Self/Test presses reach Step 18, where the status (ball-in-play) display reads 99 with every switch open and shows a closed switch's assigned matrix number for about 4.4 s; each address is closed alone for 5 s with a 1.5 s gap. Switch 57 is closed last because the first three runs showed that closing it leaves the self test (the manual's exit condition 'close tilt switch'). Direct switch writes only; nothing is held from boot.
